svg.title: Становая тяга с плинтов — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Barbell block pull, view from front three-quarter side so both blocks can be seen. A single loaded barbell with plates on BOTH ends. LEFT: each end plate rests ON TOP of its own sturdy rectangular low lifting block, bar at upper-shin level, athlete grips it with straight arms, hips hinged and knees slightly bent. BOTH SHOES on gym floor lower than blocks, never on blocks. RIGHT: stand tall with bar at front of thighs in straight arms, both blocks remain behind/below weight plates on the floor in the same location. Distinct solid blocks directly under plates, not under feet. No rack or safety rails. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
